segments.name: Radio Broadcasting
segments.description: Operates radio stations clustered to reach African-American and urban listeners through the Radio One brand.
segments.evidence: We consider our Radio Broadcasting segment to be our core radio business.

segments.name: Reach Media
products: Get Up! Mornings with Erica Campbell Show
segments.description: Operates syndicated radio shows and an African-American news website, earning mainly from advertising.
segments.evidence: Reach Media primarily derives its revenue from the sale of advertising in connection with its syndicated radio shows, including the Rickey Smiley Morning Show and the DL Hughley Show.

segments.name: Digital
segments.description: Runs social content, news, information and entertainment websites and digital brands for African-American audiences.
segments.evidence: Interactive One, LLC ("Interactive One"), our wholly owned digital platform serving the African-American community through social content, news, information, and entertainment websites, including its iONE Digital, Cassius and Bossip, HipHopWired and MadameNoire digital platforms and brands.

segments.name: Cable Television
segments.description: Operates two cable television networks, TV One and CLEO TV, targeting African-American and urban viewers.
segments.evidence: Our diverse media and entertainment interests include TV One, LLC ("TV One"), which operates two cable television networks targeting African-American and urban viewers, TV One and CLEO TV

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay for local and national advertising on radio stations, the company's core source of revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: While a core source of our revenue has historically been and remains the sale of local and national advertising for broadcast on our radio stations, our strategy is to operate the premier multi-media entertainment and information content platform targeting African-American and urban consumers.

changes.text: In 2025, part of connected TV revenue moved from the Digital segment to the Cable Television segment.
changes.evidence: Effective January 1, 2025, segment information for the prior periods has been recast in this Annual Report on Form 10-K to include reclassification of a portion of revenues from our connected TV offering from the Digital segment to the Cable Television segment.
